claim: Augments reverse generative score trajectories with approximate observation-likelihood gradients to condition inverse reconstruction.
claim_zh: 在基于得分函数的反向生成路径中加入近似的观测似然梯度，进行条件反演。
innovation_detail: Augments reverse generative score trajectories with approximate observation-likelihood gradients to condition inverse reconstruction.
innovation_detail_zh: 在基于得分函数的反向生成路径中加入近似的观测似然梯度，进行条件反演。
bottleneck: Unconditional generative priors alone do not enforce agreement with incomplete noisy measurements.
bottleneck_zh: 仅有无条件生成先验不能保证样本与稀疏含噪观测相容。
tradeoff: Guided samples are generally approximate posterior draws and require calibration tests.
